name: Azure Well-Architected Framework
description: Provides tenets, architectural decision points, and review tools intended to help solution architects build a technical foundation for their workloads based on the five core pillars: Reliability, Security, Cost Optimization, Operational Excellence, and Performance Efficiency.

alphas.name: Reliability Posture
alphas.description: Ensures that the workload meets the uptime and recovery targets by building redundancy and resiliency at scale.

states.name: Targets Defined
states.description: Business requirements and reliability targets are established.

checklist.name: Identify business requirements
checklist.description: Identify business requirements for uptime and availability.

checklist.name: Set reliability targets
checklist.description: Define quantitative Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

states.name: Designed for Resilience
states.description: Architecture incorporates redundancy and mitigates failure modes.

checklist.name: Perform failure mode analysis
checklist.description: Identify potential failure modes across all workload components.

checklist.name: Design for redundancy
checklist.description: Incorporate redundancy for critical infrastructure and network paths.

states.name: Self-Healing and Tested
states.description: The system automatically recovers from failures and is rigorously tested.

checklist.name: Implement self-healing
checklist.description: Implement automated scaling and self-healing preservation capabilities.

checklist.name: Conduct drills
checklist.description: Conduct regular disaster recovery drills and chaos engineering experiments.

alphas.name: Security Posture
alphas.description: Protects the workload from attacks by maintaining confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data and systems.

states.name: Baseline Established
states.description: Security readiness and foundational baselines are planned.

checklist.name: Establish baseline
checklist.description: Establish a security baseline and classify workload data.

checklist.name: Improve SDLC security
checklist.description: Integrate security into the development lifecycle.

states.name: Assets Protected
states.description: Workload components are segmented, encrypted, and hardened.

checklist.name: Segment components
checklist.description: Segment workload components and manage identities securely.

checklist.name: Encrypt data
checklist.description: Use encryption for data at rest and in transit.

checklist.name: Harden resources
checklist.description: Harden cloud resources and guard application secrets.

states.name: Validated and Monitored
states.description: Security testing is performed and incidents are actively managed.

checklist.name: Monitor security
checklist.description: Monitor workload security events continuously.

checklist.name: Perform security testing
checklist.description: Perform regular security testing and vulnerability scanning.

checklist.name: Respond to incidents
checklist.description: Establish and execute an incident response plan.

alphas.name: Cost Optimization State
alphas.description: Adopt an optimization mindset at organizational, architectural, and tactical levels to keep spending within budget.

states.name: Discipline Developed
states.description: Financial targets and cultural responsibility are established.

checklist.name: Create cost model
checklist.description: Create a comprehensive cost model for the workload.

checklist.name: Set guardrails
checklist.description: Set spending guardrails and budgets.

states.name: Usage Optimized
states.description: Cost optimization actions have been applied to architecture.

checklist.name: Optimize component costs
checklist.description: Optimize component costs by right-sizing resources.

checklist.name: Consolidate resources
checklist.description: Consolidate infrastructure to align usage to billing increments.

states.name: Continuously Monitored
states.description: Costs are actively monitored, visualized, and improved over time.

checklist.name: Collect cost data
checklist.description: Collect and review cost data on a recurring basis.

checklist.name: Get best rates
checklist.description: Secure the best compute rates through reservations and savings plans.

alphas.name: Operational Excellence Posture
alphas.description: Reduce issues in production by building holistic observability and automated systems.

states.name: Standards Defined
states.description: Foundational deployment and operational standards are captured.

checklist.name: Define operations
checklist.description: Define workload operational health models.

checklist.name: Establish observability strategy
checklist.description: Plan comprehensive logging and monitoring metrics.

states.name: Deployments Automated
states.description: Infrastructure and application deployments are fully automated.

checklist.name: Implement CI/CD
checklist.description: Use continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines.

checklist.name: Automate testing
checklist.description: Automate deployment testing and gated releases.

states.name: Observability Achieved
states.description: Holistic observability is in place to preempt issues.

checklist.name: Monitor production
checklist.description: Continuously monitor production telemetry.

checklist.name: Automate remediation
checklist.description: Automate remediation workflows for known operational issues.

alphas.name: Performance Efficiency Posture
alphas.description: Adjust to changes in demands placed on the workload through horizontal scaling and testing changes before deploying to production.

states.name: Targets Established
states.description: Performance targets for the workload are defined.

checklist.name: Identify performance targets
checklist.description: Identify response times, throughput, and concurrent user targets.

states.name: Scaled and Optimized
states.description: The workload uses horizontal scaling and optimized code/data structures.

checklist.name: Scale horizontally
checklist.description: Implement horizontal scaling for dynamic demand.

checklist.name: Optimize data
checklist.description: Optimize data partitioning and caching mechanisms.

states.name: Continuously Tuned
states.description: Performance testing is routine and bottlenecks are tuned.

checklist.name: Conduct load testing
checklist.description: Perform regular load and stress testing.

checklist.name: Tune performance
checklist.description: Analyze performance bottlenecks and tune system configurations.

checklist.name: Gather info
checklist.description: Gather architectural diagrams and inputs.

checklist.name: Map mitigations
checklist.description: Assign redundancy and mitigation patterns to failures.

checklist.name: Define perimeter
checklist.description: Define logical security perimeters.

checklist.name: Apply policies
checklist.description: Apply strict identity and access control policies.

workProducts.name: Cost Optimization Model
workProducts.description: Financial tracking and resource scaling policies to ensure ROI.

levelsOfDetail.description: Initial cost estimates and budgets created.

checklist.name: Estimate costs

checklist.description: Implement approval gates and automated integration tests.

workProducts.description: Results of load testing and resulting system optimizations.

activities.name: Architect for Reliability
activities.description: Design the system architecture to prevent single points of failure and recover automatically.

activities.name: Secure Workload Assets
activities.description: Apply zero-trust principles, encrypt data, and harden resources.

activities.name: Optimize Cloud Usage
activities.description: Implement right-sizing, auto-scaling, and usage monitoring to reduce waste.

activities.name: Automate Workload Deployments
activities.description: Build robust CI/CD pipelines to ensure deployments are safe, repeatable, and automated.

activities.name: Tune Performance Targets
activities.description: Analyze workload telemetry under load and optimize caching and compute resources.

workBreakdowns.name: Conduct Comprehensive WAF Assessment
workBreakdowns.description: Perform an end-to-end review of the architecture against all five pillars using the Azure Well-Architected Review tool. Estimate units: Man-Hours.

complexity.name: Assessment Complexity
complexity.description: Complexity based on legacy integrations and compliance constraints.

task.name: Assess Reliability and Security
task.description: Evaluate the current architecture for single points of failure and security vulnerabilities.

patterns.name: WAF Lifecycle Pattern
patterns.description: The sequential phases of applying the Well-Architected Framework to a workload.

patternViews.name: Architecture Assessment Phase
patternViews.description: The initial evaluation of the workload's readiness and alignment to WAF principles.

patternViews.name: Remediation and Implementation Phase
patternViews.description: Executing architectural changes to protect assets, ensure resilience, and optimize usage.

patternViews.name: Continuous Operations Phase
patternViews.description: Monitoring and tuning the workload in production.
